fields.Name: IT126 - Feature Value Only Outputs
fields.Description: Deterministic server-side bundle 'feature-value-only', sequence 49, ahead of the client-transport tests. Runs a Feature Pipeline whose three outputs have no write target through the executor over three real MJ: Entities rows, on a stub driver that answers from a table (native-typed answers), so no model is called and nothing is written to MJ: Entities. FV1 the spec validates and the two target-less constraint errors carry their exact messages; FV2 a dry run stores no Feature Value and previews 3 values per record (2 for the low-confidence record); FV3 a real run upserts every record into ValueText / ValueNumeric / ValueBoolean; FV4 an identical rerun leaves every record Unchanged; FV5 a Score below its confidence floor is withheld. Requires RUN_MUTATION_TESTS: the scratch pipeline (names start with it126-) is deleted at setup and teardown.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Five checks pass: the spec validates and refuses the two target-less constraint shapes, a dry run previews without storing, a real run stores typed values, a rerun is unchanged, and a low-confidence Score is withheld.
